  Popover props: open, anchor (RefObject), onDismiss?, align?, morph? "edge"|"anchor" (default "edge"), highlight? number|null|"follow" (default null), role?, id?, label?, activeDescendant?, tabIndex?, className?, onKeyDown?, ref?, children. It renders an absolutely positioned surface inside an anchor-positioned wrapper, handles placement, presence/morph, and drops role while closing. For a create menu use morph="anchor" highlight="follow".
  PopoverItem props: ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> plus shortcut?: string. It renders <button type="button" className="popover-item" data-popover-item> {children} {shortcut && <span className="popover-shortcut">}. So it has no separator variant.
